name: a file is written and the answer names the engine that took it
description: The canonical write. The file is the raw request body, not base64 inside a JSON document, which is what makes this domain's contract different from every other one. The response is still the envelope, because what it reports is metadata: data.engine is as load-bearing as data.handle, since the service picks the engine when the caller does not name one and a handle is only meaningful to the engine that minted it. Phorge stores the pair.
